verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh ek mek rom kee akath kathaa gursikh saadh sa(n)g mahimaa ko paaviee ||

en.bdb: The glory of a hair of a Sikh who has become one with the True Guru cannot be narrated. Then who can fathom the greatness of a congregation of such glorious Sikhs?

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek oa(n)kaar ke bithaar ko na paaraavaar sabadh surat saadh sa(n)gat samaaviee ||

en.bdb: The One Formless God whose expanse is limitless is always permeating in the congregation of devotees absorbed in His name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਨ ਜਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur saadh sa(n)g mai nivaas dhaasan dhaasaan mat aapaa na jataaviee ||

en.bdb: The True Guru who is manifest of the Lord resides in the congregation of holy men. But such Sikhs who are united with True Guru are very humble and they remain servants of Lord's servants. They shed all their ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੧੯੫॥
verses.translit_en: satigur gur gursikh saadh sa(n)gat hai ot pot jot vaa kee vaahee ban aaviee ||195||

en.bdb: True Guru is great and so are His disciples who constitute his holy congregation. The light divine of such a True Guru. entangled in the holy gathering like warp and 'weft of a cloth. Grandeur of such True Guru befits only Him and nobody can reach Him. (195)
